crossRefs.note: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe…
crossRefs.keyword: into the families. Heb. to some that were of the families

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
translations.bsb: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
translations.kjv: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
translations.asv: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
